what_this_is: The azimuth's timbre and its glide, as stereo.binaural's measured ring and 20 ms glide on the candidate's head.

entries.rationale: stereo.binaural's measured ring as sections: at each written position the ear's third-octave response relative to the front is the ring's, less what the candidate's head already draws there. Each band adds a fixed boost and a fixed cut, each less the dry path, by weights that follow the placement (a section's gain may not vary), fitted at the 31 written positions against the C++ panner; the left ear reads the same weights at the mirrored placement. tests/midi/gs_classic_types_01b_test.cpp holds the result to the panner.
The candidate's ear gain, under a new id so the azimuth sections can take the id it fed.
